function: Distributed learned allocation of BS computation capacity and of BS-satellite TDMA time slots among users (resource allocation on a satellite link) to minimize total edge-computing delay (p. 8, 10).
system: One satellite (8000 km), ten BSs, five users each; TDMA links of 10 MHz (user-BS) and 200 MHz (BS-satellite); antennas and carrier not stated; no RIS (p. 11-12).
method: MADDPG reinforcement learning with centralized training and decentralized execution, twin critics, actor and critic of three linear layers with 256 hidden units (p. 10, 12).
data_channel: Custom PyTorch simulation with random task sizes, fixed powers (30 dBm user, 43 dBm BS), noise -174 dBm/Hz; channel-gain model never specified; no dataset or measurements (p. 12).
test_conditions: Centralized training, decentralized execution in one simulated scenario; sweeps over data size, satellite and BS capacity, BS number, orbit altitude, CSI error; no separate test scenario (p. 12-15).
baselines: Non-learned: PSO-Distributed, PSO-Centralized, Average, Greedy; learned: MARL-CTCE, the same MARL with centralized execution, a variant of the proposed scheme (p. 12).
metrics: Total system delay, average task delay, share of tasks offloaded to the satellite, delay error rate under CSI error, 95% confidence intervals, GPU memory and training time (p. 12-15).
complexity: Training O(N N_T N_B (sum U_l U_{l+1} + 2 sum V_h V_{h+1})), execution O(sum U_l U_{l+1}) per BS; Algorithm 1 O(N^2 K^2); GPU memory reported (p. 11, 15).
openness: none (PyTorch and PettingZoo named; no code or data link).
q1_support: p. 11: "other main parameters are shown in Table I"; Table I (p. 12) lists bandwidths, powers, noise density and task sizes only. Missing: any stated channel model, any 3GPP, COST 2100 or DeepMIMO model, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 14: "Fig. 7 illustrates the simulation for different BS numbers". Sweeps over data size, capacities, BS number, altitude and a CSI-error robustness test (p. 15) are reported, but the paper never says a trained policy is tested in a setting different from its training one.
q3_support: p. 12: "MARL-CTCE: Centralized offloading scheme is applied." is the only learned baseline and is the proposed MARL with centralized execution, a variant of the method. PSO-Distributed, PSO-Centralized, Average and Greedy are non-learned. Missing: an earlier learned method or a standard learning algorithm for the same problem.
q4_support: p. 11: "the total computational complexity for N BSs during training is obtained by [28]" (eq. 34), with the execution complexity and O(N^2 K^2) for Algorithm 1 in the same section; Table III (p. 15) gives GPU memory and training time.
q5_support: p. 11: "This article conducted the simulations based on Pytorch" on a custom simulation. Missing: any code or data link or DOI, and any public or measured channel dataset; Table I (p. 12) only names PettingZoo as an RL environment library.
notes: Borderline above_phy: the learned outputs are the BS computation capacity (edge computing, above PHY) and the BS-satellite TDMA time slots (resource allocation on a satellite link, p. 8 and 10), so the work is included under the satellite-link resource allocation rule as area 6; if the reviewer reads the time slots as scheduling, the reason would be above_phy. The agents observe task sizes and past allocations, not CSI (p. 8). The task splitting ratio and the user-BS slots are closed-form, not learned (p. 5, 8). q3 is 0 because MARL-CTCE is a variant of the proposed MARL.
